title: Anti-Collapse Dynamics and the Emergence of Multi-Time-Scale Learning in Recurrent Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.29519v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-range learning is hard for recurrent networks trained with stochastic gradient descent, because the influence of a past input fades with the lag $\ell$, and if it fades too fast the dependence cannot be learned from finite data. This fade is captured by an envelope $f(\ell)$. An exponential fade makes the data needed to learn a lag-$\ell$ dependence grow exponentially, putting long horizons out of reach; a power-law fade keeps the cost polynomial. We show that the asymptotic decay behavior of $f(\ell)$ is not fixed by the architecture. Instead, it emerges from the coupling between the state dynamics and parameter dynamics, settling into either a collapsed regime (fast, exponential forgetting) or an extended, anti-collapsed regime (slow, power-law forgetting). translated_title: 反坍缩动力学与递归神经网络中多时间尺度学习的涌现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.29519v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：对于使用随机梯度下降训练的递归网络，长程学习是困难的，因为过去输入的影响会随着滞后ℓ而衰减，如果衰减过快，则无法从有限数据中学习这种依赖性。这种衰减由一个包络函数f(ℓ)描述。指数衰减使得学习滞后ℓ依赖性所需的数据呈指数增长，使长时域变得遥不可及；而幂律衰减则保持成本为多项式级别。我们表明，f(ℓ)的渐近衰减行为并非由架构固定。相反，它从状态动力学与参数动力学之间的耦合中涌现，并稳定在坍缩态（快速、指数遗忘）或扩展的反坍缩态（缓慢、幂律遗忘）。其直觉是这些耦合动力学中的竞争。训练驱动网络的有效时间尺度向短尺度移动，而罕见、重尾的波动则...
tldr: 本文揭示了递归神经网络中遗忘速率（指数或幂律）并非由架构预设，而是由状态与参数动力学的耦合自发涌现，形成坍缩或反坍缩两种状态，从而决定长程学习的可行性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the forgetting rate (exponential or power-law) in recurrent neural networks is not predetermined by architecture but emerges from coupled state-parameter dynamics, settling into collapsed or anti-collapsed regimes that determine long-range learning feasibility.
